Gabriela Women’s Party on Wednesday filed an appeal letter to the Commission on Elections (Comelec) urging it be proclaimed as one of the winning party-list groups in Eleksyon 2025.

On Wednesday, members of the women' s organization staged a rally outside the Comelec main office in Intramuros, Manila and to submit consolidated letters of appeal from marginalized sectors including solo parents, LGBTQIA+, and child rights advocates to call for the disqualification of Duterte Youth with finality and for the proclamation of Gabriela.
